categories.main_business_segments: First Industrial Realty Trust, Inc. operates as a self-administered and fully integrated real estate investment trust (REIT) focused on the ownership, management, acquisition, development, and redevelopment of industrial real estate. Its portfolio is primarily composed of bulk warehouse, regional warehouse, light industrial, and R&D/flex properties, with a strategic emphasis on bulk and regional warehouses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations involve the acquisition, development, and management of industrial properties using modern construction standards and sustainable building practices. Development projects often pursue LEED certification, and the company employs a decentralized property management model supported by regional teams and local managers, leveraging technology for property operations, leasing, and tenant engagement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FR serves a diverse base of over 950 tenants across industries such as e-commerce, third-party logistics, transportation, consumer products, retail, food and beverage, building materials, health services, and government. Its properties are designed to meet the needs of logistics, distribution, and light manufacturing tenants, with no single tenant accounting for more than 6.8% of rent revenues.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates in 19 U.S. states, with a focus on 15 target logistics markets that include major metropolitan areas such as Southern California, Chicago, Dallas/Ft. Worth, Central/Eastern Pennsylvania, Atlanta, New Jersey, Phoenix, Denver, South Florida, and others. These markets are selected for their favorable industrial fundamentals, population growth, and barriers to entry.
categories.supply_chain_position: First Industrial operates downstream in the supply chain as an owner, developer, and lessor of industrial real estate, providing critical infrastructure for warehousing, distribution, and light manufacturing tenants. It does not engage in manufacturing or logistics services directly but enables these activities through its property portfolio.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include maximizing shareholder returns through internal growth (rent increases, occupancy gains, cost control), external growth (development and acquisition in target markets), and portfolio enhancement (upgrading assets and recycling capital). Sustainability, tenant engagement on environmental practices, and selective development of best-in-class properties are key innovation themes.
categories.revenue_model: FR generates revenue primarily through lease income from its industrial property portfolio, with most leases structured as net or semi-net, passing through property operating expenses to tenants. Additional revenue streams include tenant recoveries, development fees, and gains on property sales. The company also earns management and incentive fees from joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other public industrial REITs (such as Prologis and Duke Realty), private real estate funds, and developers for both property acquisitions and tenants. FR positions itself as a leading pure-play industrial REIT with a focus on high-growth, supply-constrained U.S. logistics markets, leveraging its scale and operational expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2021, FR owned 404 in-service properties totaling approximately 60.7 million square feet, with total assets of $4.2 billion and annual revenues of $476 million. The company demonstrated strong growth in 2021, with net income of $277 million, high occupancy (98.1%), and a robust development pipeline, reflecting a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: First Industrial emphasizes its ability to deliver high-quality, strategically located industrial properties that support tenant logistics and distribution needs, with a focus on operational efficiency, tenant satisfaction, and sustainability. Its disciplined market selection, decentralized management, and commitment to portfolio quality and ESG initiatives differentiate it from competitors.
